Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
XZealot wrote:
> LSJ,
> Can you tap Valerius Maior (tapping a tapped vampire) to burn the
baleful
> doll then pay his infernal penalty to untap him?

He can, but doing so won't burn any of the target's blood, since he has
to tap "to" get that effect.

Messages.Author: Robert Scythe
Messages.Body:
Fabio Sooner Macedo wrote:

> I guess it would work with the Path of Evil Revelations, no?
(assuming
> Valerius is untapped at the beginning of your turn)
>
> Tap him during untap to burn the Doll, then untap him again via Path.

The original question had to do with tapping an already tapped minion,
which LSJ responded to. If, for any reason, Valerius was untapped at
the beginning of the turn, you could tap him with the Doll and then
untap him via his infernalism (Path or not).
